PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

   C. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
